source_refs.note: Exercise 3.4, Question 10: Exercise 3.4, book page 94: Q1-Q15 (integration by partial fractions); answers book pages 301-302

blocks.explanation:
Pehli nazar mein yeh lamba Case-II sawal lagta hai: \((x + 1)^3\) ke teen fractions aur \((x + 2)\) ka ek, yani chaar constants.
Lekin ek achha student pehle yeh dekhta hai ke kya numerator aur denominator mein koi factor common hai.
\(x = -1\) rakhne se numerator zero ho jata hai, yani \(x + 1\) us ka factor hai; asal mein numerator \((x + 1)^2(x + 2)\) hai.
Plan: numerator factorise, cancel, aur jo chhota sa fraction bache us ka integral.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int \frac{x^3 + 4x^2 + 5x + 2}{(x + 1)^3(x + 2)}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: yeh integral.
Tareeqa: pehle common factors dhoondhna (factor theorem). Agar factor cancel ho jaye to partial fractions ka saara lamba kaam bach jata hai. Yeh aadat exam mein bohat waqt bachati hai.

Numerator ko denominator ke roots par check karein
\[x = -1:\ -1 + 4 - 5 + 2 = 0\]
\[x = -2:\ -8 + 16 - 10 + 2 = 0\]
Kyun: Factor theorem: agar \(p(a) = 0\) ho to \(x - a\), \(p(x)\) ka factor hai. Dono values par zero aaya, yani \(x + 1\) aur \(x + 2\) dono numerator ke factors hain.

Numerator factorise karein
\[x^3 + 4x^2 + 5x + 2 = (x + 1)(x^2 + 3x + 2)\]
\[= (x + 1)(x + 1)(x + 2) = (x + 1)^2(x + 2)\]
Kyun: \(x + 1\) se divide (synthetic division se coefficients 1, 4, 5, 2 se 1, 3, 2 milte hain) kiya to \(x^2 + 3x + 2\) bacha, jo \((x + 1)(x + 2)\) hai (product 2, jama 3).

Cancel karein
\[\dfrac{(x + 1)^2(x + 2)}{(x + 1)^3(x + 2)} = \dfrac{1}{x + 1}\]
Kyun: Upar \((x + 1)^2\) aur neeche \((x + 1)^3\): do cancel ho kar neeche ek \((x + 1)\) bacha. \((x + 2)\) poora cancel. Yeh \(x \ne -1, -2\) ke liye sahi hai, jahan fraction defined hai.

Integral lein
\[\int \dfrac{dx}{x + 1} = \ln|x + 1| + c\]
Kyun: Seedha formula \(\int \frac{dx}{x + a} = \ln|x + a| + c\). Itna lamba dikhne wala sawal ek line ka nikla.

Tasdeeq
\[(x + 1)^2(x + 2) = (x^2 + 2x + 1)(x + 2)\]
\[= x^3 + 4x^2 + 5x + 2 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Factorised shakal ko khol kar dekha to asal numerator wapas aa gaya. Agar koi chaar constants wala poora partial fraction kare to bhi yahi milega: \(\frac{1}{x + 1}\) ka constant 1 aur baaqi sab zero.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke aakhir mein answers (page 302) mein Exercise 3.4 ke jawab ghalat heading "Exercise 3.6" ke neeche chhape hain. Is sawal ka jawab us block ka item (x) hai: \(\ln|x + 1| + c\). Yeh jawab sahi hai. Jis block par "Exercise 3.4" likha hai (page 301) woh kisi aur exercise ke jawab hain, is liye wahan se milane ki koshish na karein.
